title: Biparametric MRI with deep learning for the preoperative prediction of muscle invasion in patients with bladder cancer: a multicenter study
summary: Three-institution pathology-referenced cohorts show biparametric MRI deep learning predicts bladder muscle invasion; retrospective cohorts and manual segmentation limit generalization.
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material
